resources.string: Holds the live event connection to the user\'s own Jarvis backend, running on their own machine, so approval requests arrive while the screen is off.
Ongoing connection to your Jarvis backend.
A decision is waiting. This channel makes a sound: it is the only thing that tells you an approval arrived while the app was closed.
Approvals that can be undone and stay on your desktop, and approvals raised only because a message tried to hurry you. Shown without a sound.
A decision is waiting. Unlock to see it.
The oldest pending approval, at a glance. Deny answers it directly; approving always opens the app.
The link status, and a one-tap Talk button that opens the app with the hold-to-talk mic ready - it does not record from the widget itself.
